detail.longDescription:
Whatever happened to proper business etiquette?!?! I mean, do folks realise not responding to other people doesn’t work really too well towards their own reputation as professional workers? 

Setting up Web meetings, for instance, to then be greeted with a no-show, not even a short message to confirm / decline, is not really pleasant and sends a clear message: “I can’t be bothered about your time, but only mine. No sorry” 😔

Why? 🤔

#SmartWork #Productivity #Collaboration
